description: Release of Runescape-Stack-Fabric, addon for Minescape! This addon display Runescape-like stack for all items on the server. Furthermore, you can also see your cash stack texture changing as your stack grow.

mods.name: Runescape Stack Fabric
mods.description: This addon display Runescape-like stack for all items on the server. Furthermore, you can also see your cash stack texture changing as your stack grow.

releases.notes:
Release of RuneStack for Fabric. Enjoy!

This mod display stack like in runescape. It become more easy to manage your bank.
Display durability bar on degradable items.
Display charges left on jewerly.
Stack display also work on slayer task.

Toggle the mod on or off using 'M'.

v1.0.1:
Fix crash issue when jewerly has over it's max charge.
Fix stack display on slayer tasks.
